ev.q: 61.1% of children and adolescents reported 60 minutes of physical activity most days or every day
from 70.4% among those with ≤2 hours of screen time to 54.4% among those with ≥4 hours of screen time
Physical activity decreased with increasing hours of screen time use
Estimates are based on a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population and were self-reported by children and adolescents aged 12–17 years.

methods_quotes.q: With 95% CIs indicated by error bars.
